name: Click Ripple
description: Every click sends a ring rippling out from the pointer. Pressing a button launches a ring that eases outward and fades as it grows, and releasing it sends a thinner second ring after the first. Each button has its own ring colour. The rings draw over the cursor so they stay visible on top of it.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: Diameter the ring grows to before it is gone (px)

parameters.name: Thickness
parameters.description: Line thickness of the press ring (px)

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: How long a ring takes to expand and fade (seconds)

parameters.name: Left button
parameters.description: Ring colour for the left button

parameters.name: Right button
parameters.description: Ring colour for the right button

parameters.name: Middle button
parameters.description: Ring colour for the middle button
